optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Mobile Application Engineer, Enterprise Knowledge Base

professionalSummary.text: Develops and maintains the offline sync and search features of the knowledge base app on iOS and Android.
professionalSummary.witness: Developed the delta-sync module for the knowledge base app (Kotlin and Swift), replacing the full-catalogue download with change-set downloads and a resumable transfer when field devices lose connectivity.

experienceHighlights.text: Improves app quality indicators such as crash-free sessions or sync failure rate, reported against a documented baseline.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reduced the sync failure rate from 6.8 percent to 2.1 percent of sync attempts between the March and June releases, measured by the app analytics dashboard against the product's published baseline of 6.8 percent for the January to February period.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Coordinates release contents with the content team and records own responsibility boundaries for each release.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Coordinated release contents with the content team for four releases; my part covered the sync and search changes, while the release manager decided the release date and scope.

skills.text: Investigates crash and sync reports from field staff and documents root causes.
skills.witness: Triaged crash and sync reports from field staff through the support queue, documenting root causes in the engineering wiki and linking each to the fixing change.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience with offline sync development, quality improvement, release coordination, and crash investigation. They do not establish the candidate's ability to document known limitations and hand-over conditions for each app release.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate's qualifications are supported by the provided evidence, but further human review is required to assess the completeness of the evidence and to evaluate the candidate's ability to document known limitations and hand-over conditions for each app release.
